mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM transaction payment JOIN transaction capture ON capture.parent_transaction_id = payment.transaction_id JOIN transaction_type tt ON tt.transaction_type_id = capture.transaction_type_id JOIN transaction_event te ON te.transaction_id = capture.transaction_id JOIN transaction_event_type tet ON tet.transaction_event_type_id = te.transaction_event_type_id WHERE payment.reference = #{paymentReference} AND tt.code = 'CAPTURE' AND tet.code = 'CAPTURED' )

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ri.net_amount), 0) AS net, COALESCE(SUM(ri.tax_amount), 0) AS tax FROM refund_item ri JOIN transaction t ON t.transaction_id = ri.refund_id WHERE ri.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND t.reference != #{excludingRefundReference} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM transaction_event te JOIN transaction_event_type tet ON tet.transaction_event_type_id = te.transaction_event_type_id WHERE te.transaction_id = t.transaction_id AND tet.code = 'REFUND_FAILED' )
SELECT transaction_id FROM transaction WHERE reference = #{reference}
